title: Headless SITL in Docker: ArduCopter and PX4 SIH with one compose file
summary: Dockerfiles and a compose file that run ArduCopter 4.6.3 SITL (with a simulated vicon for ExternalNav) and PX4 v1.17.0 SIH quadrotor without Gazebo or a GUI, plus a Python client image with pymavlink and mavsdk-grpc that shares the PX4 network namespace. Built and flown on linux/arm64 (Apple Silicon).
verified: Built and ran on 2026-11-06 with Docker 29.5.2 on Apple Silicon (linux/arm64): both SITL images built, the ArduPilot, PX4 and VIO bridge samples flew against them, and docker compose (v5.7.0, run from the docker:29-cli image) brought both services up and a client container reached both. amd64 not tested.
